description.value: Off The Rail Brewing is an East Vancouver craft brewery and tasting room founded by Steve Forsyth, pouring up to 12 house-brewed beers on 15 taps including rare nitro pours unavailable elsewhere. It sits directly on the Adanac Street bike path — one of Vancouver's primary cycling corridors — and has cultivated a loyal following among cyclists who stop in on rides. The tasting room serves snack food alongside its beer flights and pints, and sells packaged beer and growler fills to go.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active craft brewery tasting room at 1351 Adanac Street, explicitly described as located on 'the Adanac bike path, which is well known as one of the major cycling highways in the city,' satisfying the bike-visibility criterion; multiple testimonials also reference stopping in on the bike route. The tasting room page confirms packaged beer sales and growler fills for takeout, and lists Potato Pea Samosas confirming a vegetarian food option. No explicit evidence for bike racks, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other amenities was found in the website text.
concerns: OSM address field contains only 'Vancouver'; full street address (1351 Adanac Street, Vancouver, BC V5L 2C4) sourced from website contact page — address contact_confirmed set to null as no specific OSM street address was available to compare.

Front page retains COVID-era social distancing messaging ('Thank you for respecting our social distancing measures'), suggesting some website content has not been updated, though the business otherwise appears currently operational.

OSM node name is 'Off The Rail Tasting Room' while the business brand is consistently 'Off The Rail Brewing' / 'Off the Rail Brewing Co.' on the website — the OSM node appears to refer specifically to the tasting room portion of the brewery premises.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Explicitly cyclist-facing business on a major Vancouver bike route; the tasting room page directly addresses touring cyclists by name and multiple customer testimonials reference stopping in on the bike path.
